title: parseCreatures real-PDF coverage gap (193/300+) after column-aware extraction
description:
With column-aware extraction in place (loreweaver-fct), parseCreatures advances from 0 stat blocks to 193 on the real SRD 5.1 PDF, but the MIN_EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_CREATURES floor of 300 still fails verify:dnd5e-srd-pack. The remaining gap is no longer about page-level column layout — that work landed in loreweaver-fct — it's about creature-specific stat-block structure the parser doesn't yet recognize.

Investigation needed:
- Diff the 193 parsed creature names against the SRD 5.1 monsters chapter ToC to identify which families are missing (initial scan suggests Beasts / animal stat blocks are largely absent; Bandit/Cultist/etc. are intentionally out of scope per the existing 'Nonplayer Characters' exclusion).
- Determine whether the misses are sectioning (a sub-section like 'Beasts' the slicer doesn't anchor) or parser pattern coverage (meta-line / stat-line shapes outside the current regexes).
- Confirm parseFeatures status on the real PDF (currently masked by the creature coverage check failing first).

Reproduce: npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack. See packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseCreatures.ts and sections.ts.
notes:
Root causes of the 193/300 gap, in order of impact:

1. Wrong floor — SRD 5.1 CC Monsters chapter has ~201 creatures, not 300+. The Misc Creatures appendix (MM-A) was never sliced.
2. Misc Creatures appendix (p366-394) was never sliced — adds ~95 beasts/animals/swarms.
3. Column partition picked the absolute-largest x-gap; on monster pages a far-right outlier opens a larger gap than the real gutter, so partition fell back and the page emitted y-interleaved across columns.
4. Narrow-gutter pages (49pt < 50pt threshold) were not partitioned, with the same interleaving symptom.
5. Ability-score row was found via positional adjacency to "STR DEX CON…" header; column interleaving inserts a prose line between them and the score row was missed → stat block silently dropped.
6. Compound creature names embed `-­‐` (U+002D + U+00AD soft hyphen + U+2010 Unicode hyphen) which broke the name char class; Will-o'-Wisp, Saber-Toothed Tiger, Half-Red Dragon Veteran dropped.

Fixes (PR coming on branch loreweaver-w8h):
- sections.ts: add `miscellaneousCreatures` anchor for Appendix MM-A; orchestrator concatenates with main Monsters slice.
- extract.ts: partition now picks the largest VALID gap (above threshold, passes both per-side guards), not the absolute-largest. Threshold lowered 50→45 to catch narrow-gutter pages.
- parseCreatures.ts: ability-score row detected by its own six-cell pattern (first-match-wins), not by "header line + next non-blank". Soft hyphens stripped, U+2010 folded to ASCII, runs collapsed.
- index.ts: MIN_EXPECTED_SRD_5_1_CREATURES lowered from 300 to 280. Real ceiling is 296 (201 Monsters + 95 MM-A).

Result: parseCreatures yields 296 creatures (was 193); creature coverage passes.

parseFeatures status (called out in this bead): UNVERIFIED on real PDF. verify:dnd5e-srd-pack now blocks on a downstream ancestry coverage failure (13/18 subraces missing — Mountain Dwarf, Wood Elf, Dark Elf (Drow), Stout Halfling, Forest Gnome). Filed as loreweaver-3m1; parseFeatures should be re-checked after that lands.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #132 (loreweaver-w8h branch). parseCreatures now yields 296 stat blocks vs prior 193; creature coverage gate passes. Five interacting bugs addressed: Appendix MM-A slice added, column partition picks largest valid gap (not absolute largest), COLUMN_GAP_THRESHOLD 50→45, ability-score row identified by its own pattern, soft hyphens normalized. Floor lowered 300→280 (real ceiling 296). Downstream ancestry coverage failure filed as loreweaver-3m1.
